districts.name: Lebanon Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: South-central Boone County: Lebanon and Ulen plus most of Whitestown (Worth and Perry townships).

districts.name: Western Boone County Community School District
districts.boundary_note: Western Boone County, including Thorntown, Jamestown, and Advance.

districts.name: Zionsville Community Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves Eagle and Union Townships; covers Zionsville and the southeastern (Anson) area of Whitestown.

districts.name: Carmel Clay Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves the City of Carmel and Clay Township.

districts.name: Hamilton Heights School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Covers northern Hamilton County (Jackson and White River townships); serves Cicero, Arcadia and Atlanta.

districts.name: Hamilton Southeastern Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves all of Fishers plus a southern portion of Noblesville.

districts.name: Noblesville Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves most of Noblesville; a southern portion falls in Hamilton Southeastern.

districts.name: Sheridan Community Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves the Town of Sheridan and Adams Township in northwestern Hamilton County.

districts.name: Westfield Washington Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves the City of Westfield and Washington Township.

districts.name: Eastern Hancock County Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves eastern Hancock County; Shirley's Hancock-County (Brown Township) portion attends here.

districts.name: Mt. Vernon Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Covers Vernon and Buck Creek townships in northwest Hancock County; includes McCordsville, Fortville, and part of Cumberland.

districts.name: New Palestine Community Schools
districts.boundary_note: Formerly the Community School Corporation of Southern Hancock County; renamed 2024-25. Serves southwestern Hancock County, including the Sugar Creek Township part of Cumberland.

districts.name: Brownsburg Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves most of Brownsburg; a northwest portion falls in North West Hendricks School Corporation.

districts.name: Mill Creek Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Clay, Franklin, and Liberty townships — Clayton, Coatesville, Amo, Stilesville, plus a small section of Plainfield. High school is Cascade.

districts.name: North West Hendricks School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Covers Eel River, Middle, and Union townships — Pittsboro, Lizton, North Salem, plus portions of Brownsburg. High school is Tri-West Hendricks.

districts.name: Plainfield Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the town of Plainfield (Guilford Township); a small western section lies in Mill Creek.

districts.name: Charles A. Beard Memorial School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Henry County district (Knightstown) serving the Henry-County portion of Shirley.

districts.name: Center Grove Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves White River Township — the western portions of Greenwood and most of Bargersville.

districts.name: Clark-Pleasant Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Headquartered in Whiteland; covers New Whiteland, southern/southeastern Greenwood, and a small section of Franklin. Whiteland Community High School is its high school.

districts.name: Edinburgh Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the town of Edinburgh and Blue River Township.

districts.name: Franklin Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves almost all of Franklin plus a small section of Bargersville.

districts.name: Greenwood Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the older, central/established areas of the City of Greenwood.

districts.name: Nineveh-Hensley-Jackson United School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Branded 'Indian Creek Schools,' headquartered in Trafalgar; serves Trafalgar, Nineveh, Princes Lakes and Morgantown.

districts.name: Alexandria Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves Alexandria and Orestes; schools operate under the Alexandria-Monroe name.

districts.name: Anderson Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Primary district for Anderson; also serves Edgewood, River Forest, and most of Chesterfield.

districts.name: Elwood Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves Elwood (Pipe Creek Township).

districts.name: Frankton-Lapel Community Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves all of Lapel plus Frankton and the northwestern edge of the Anderson area (Lafayette Township).

districts.name: South Madison Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves Pendleton, Ingalls, and Markleville; high school is Pendleton Heights.

districts.name: Beech Grove City Schools
districts.boundary_note: Independent district serving the City of Beech Grove, an enclave within Marion County.

districts.name: Indianapolis Public Schools
districts.boundary_note: Covers the historic urban core — including Broad Ripple Village and the Irvington Historic District.

districts.name: MSD of Franklin Township
districts.boundary_note: Eastern parts of the broader Southport area (46237) fall in MSD of Franklin Township.

districts.name: MSD of Lawrence Township
districts.boundary_note: Serves the City of Lawrence and most of Lawrence Township, including the Marion County side of Geist.

districts.name: MSD of Perry Township
districts.boundary_note: Serves the City of Southport and surrounding Perry Township.

districts.name: MSD of Pike Township
districts.boundary_note: Serves the Eagle Creek area of northwest Marion County.

districts.name: MSD of Warren Township
districts.boundary_note: Serves east-side areas beyond the Irvington Historic District.

districts.name: MSD of Washington Township
districts.boundary_note: Serves northern and surrounding portions of the broader Broad Ripple area; the Village core is IPS.

districts.name: School Town of Speedway
districts.boundary_note: Independent district serving the Town of Speedway.

districts.name: Metropolitan School District of Martinsville
districts.boundary_note: Serves the greater Martinsville area of central Morgan County.

districts.name: Monroe-Gregg School District
districts.boundary_note: Serves Monroe and Gregg Townships (Monrovia).

districts.name: Mooresville Consolidated School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the Mooresville area of northern Morgan County.

districts.name: Northwestern Consolidated School District of Shelby County
districts.boundary_note: Operates the Triton Central schools; serves northwestern Shelby County including Fairland.

districts.name: Shelby Eastern Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves eastern Shelby County with Morristown and Waldron campuses.

districts.name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel School
districts.short_name: Our Lady of Mount Carmel School

districts.name: St. Louis de Montfort Catholic School
districts.short_name: St. Louis de Montfort Catholic School

districts.name: Our Lady of the Greenwood Catholic School
districts.short_name: Our Lady of the Greenwood Catholic School

districts.name: St. Rose of Lima Catholic School
districts.short_name: St. Rose of Lima Catholic School

districts.name: Brown County School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Single county-wide district covering all of Brown County, including Nashville and Bean Blossom.

districts.name: Greensburg Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: City district serving Greensburg; rural Decatur County is served by Decatur County Community Schools.

districts.name: Decatur County Community Schools
districts.boundary_note: Serves rural Decatur County outside Greensburg via North Decatur and South Decatur campuses; Westport is in the South Decatur attendance area.

districts.name: Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the city of Columbus and all but two townships in Bartholomew County (all except Hawcreek and Flatrock).

districts.name: Flat Rock-Hawcreek School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves eastern Bartholomew County — the town of Hope and Hawcreek and Flatrock townships. Does not serve the city of Columbus.

districts.name: Jennings County School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Single countywide district serving all of Jennings County, including North Vernon.

districts.name: Crawfordsville Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the city of Crawfordsville; rural Montgomery County is served by North Montgomery and South Montgomery.

districts.name: Greencastle Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves Greencastle plus Greencastle and Madison townships; rural Putnam County is served by North Putnam and South Putnam.

districts.name: Cloverdale Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves the town of Cloverdale and Cloverdale Township in southern Putnam County.

districts.name: North Central Parke Community School Corporation
districts.boundary_note: Serves Rockville (HQ), Bloomingdale, and Marshall; the 2013 merger of the former Rockville and Turkey Run districts. Southwestern Parke County is served by Southwest Parke.

Carmel.note: All of Carmel is served by Carmel Clay Schools.

Fishers.note: The entire City of Fishers is served by Hamilton Southeastern Schools.

Noblesville.note: Most of Noblesville is Noblesville Schools; a southern/southeastern portion lies in Hamilton Southeastern Schools.

Westfield.note: All of Westfield is served by Westfield Washington Schools.

Cicero.note: Cicero is served by Hamilton Heights School Corporation.

Arcadia.note: Arcadia is served by Hamilton Heights School Corporation; the district office is in Arcadia.

Atlanta.note: Atlanta is served by Hamilton Heights School Corporation.

Sheridan.note: Sheridan is served by Sheridan Community Schools (Adams Township).

Greenwood.note: Assignment depends on the address — west-side Greenwood (White River Township) is Center Grove, the established central/older areas are Greenwood Community, and southern/southeastern pockets fall in Clark-Pleasant.

Franklin.note: Nearly all of Franklin is Franklin Community; a very small section falls within Clark-Pleasant.

Bargersville.note: Most of Bargersville is Center Grove (White River Township); a portion on the Franklin side is Franklin Community.

Whiteland.note: Whiteland (and New Whiteland) are served by Clark-Pleasant; Whiteland Community High School is the district high school.

Edinburgh.note: Edinburgh is served by Edinburgh Community School Corporation.

Trafalgar.note: Trafalgar is served by Nineveh-Hensley-Jackson United School Corporation, branded Indian Creek Schools.

Avon.note: Avon is served by Avon Community School Corporation.

Brownsburg.note: Brownsburg Community Schools serves most of the town; a small northwest portion is in North West Hendricks.

Plainfield.note: Plainfield Community Schools serves the town; a small western section is in Mill Creek.

Danville.note: Danville is served by Danville Community School Corporation.

Pittsboro.note: Pittsboro's schools are part of North West Hendricks.

Clayton.note: Cascade schools in Clayton are part of Mill Creek Community School Corporation.

Zionsville.note: All of Zionsville is served by Zionsville Community Schools.

Whitestown.note: Whitestown is split: the Eagle Township/southeast (Anson) area attends Zionsville, while the Worth and Perry Township areas (most of the older town) attend Lebanon.

Lebanon.note: Lebanon is served by Lebanon Community School Corporation.

Thorntown.note: Home to the Western Boone district offices and Western Boone Jr-Sr High School.

Jamestown.note: Served by Western Boone County Community School District.

Mooresville.note: Served by Mooresville Consolidated School Corporation.

Martinsville.note: Served by the Metropolitan School District of Martinsville.

Beech Grove.note: Independent enclave city district; not part of IPS or a township MSD.

Speedway.note: Independent enclave town district on the west side.

Southport.note: MSD of Perry Township serves the City of Southport; eastern parts of the broader 46237 area fall in MSD of Franklin Township.

Lawrence.note: The City of Lawrence is served by MSD of Lawrence Township.

Broad Ripple.note: Broad Ripple Village core is within IPS; surrounding northern areas are served by MSD of Washington Township.

Irvington.note: The Irvington Historic District is within IPS; areas farther east are served by MSD of Warren Township.

Geist.note: Geist straddles the county line: the Marion County side is MSD of Lawrence Township; the Hamilton County (Fishers) side is Hamilton Southeastern Schools.

Eagle Creek.note: Served by MSD of Pike Township in northwest Marion County.

McCordsville.note: McCordsville is served entirely by Mt. Vernon Community School Corporation.

Fortville.note: Fortville is served by Mt. Vernon Community School Corporation.

Greenfield.note: Greenfield is served by Greenfield-Central Community School Corporation.

New Palestine.note: New Palestine is served by New Palestine Community Schools (formerly Southern Hancock).

Cumberland.note: Cumberland straddles the Marion-Hancock county line across three townships, so it is split among MSD of Warren Township, Mt. Vernon, and New Palestine. Attendance depends on which part of town a home is in.

Shirley.note: Shirley straddles the Hancock-Henry county line: the larger Hancock (Brown Township) portion attends Eastern Hancock; the Henry-County portion attends Charles A. Beard.

Shelbyville.note: Shelbyville is served by Shelbyville Central Schools.

Fairland.note: Fairland is served by the Northwestern Consolidated School District of Shelby County (Triton Central).

Morristown.note: Morristown is served by Shelby Eastern Schools.

Waldron.note: Waldron is served by Shelby Eastern Schools.

Anderson.note: Anderson Community School Corporation serves the majority of the city; the northwestern edge (Lafayette Township) falls in Frankton-Lapel.

Pendleton.note: Served entirely by South Madison Community School Corporation (Pendleton Heights).

Alexandria.note: Served by Alexandria Community School Corporation (Alexandria-Monroe).

Elwood.note: Served entirely by Elwood Community School Corporation.

Nashville.note: Served by the single county-wide Brown County School Corporation.

Bean Blossom.note: An unincorporated community in Brown County, served by the county-wide Brown County School Corporation.

Greensburg.note: The city is served by Greensburg Community Schools; surrounding rural Decatur County is served by Decatur County Community Schools.

Westport.note: Sand Creek Township; served by Decatur County Community Schools (South Decatur campus).

Columbus.note: The city of Columbus is served by Bartholomew Consolidated School Corporation (BCSC). The separate Flat Rock-Hawcreek School Corporation covers eastern Bartholomew County (the Hope area), not the city itself.

Seymour.note: Seymour is served entirely by Seymour Community School Corporation. Trinity Lutheran High School is a regional LCMS high school.

North Vernon.note: Jennings County is a single countywide district; North Vernon is its county seat. St. Mary's is a K-8 Catholic school.

Crawfordsville.note: The city is served entirely by Crawfordsville Community School Corporation; North Montgomery and South Montgomery serve rural Montgomery County.

Greencastle.note: Served by Greencastle Community School Corporation; North Putnam and South Putnam serve rural Putnam County.

Cloverdale.note: Served by Cloverdale Community School Corporation.

Rockville.note: Served by North Central Parke Community School Corporation (the 2013 merger of the former Rockville and Turkey Run districts).
